name: Chezmoi Hound
author: Enis Budancamanak
description: A bar count of dotfile drift that hunts it down. It adds up what this machine has edited and the source has not captured, what the source repo has not committed or pushed, what the remote has that this machine has not pulled, due run scripts and new files under ~/.claude, and shows the other machine's state over SSH. The panel offers to pull, capture, commit, push and run scripts.

barWidget.description: Dotfile drift across $HOME, the source repo, its remote and a peer machine, with pull, capture, commit, push and script actions.

schema.label: chezmoi source directory
schema.description: Leave empty to use chezmoi's own configured source. Set it when the source is a tree you normally pass to `chezmoi --source`, such as ~/Projects/dotfiles.

schema.label: AI command for commit messages
schema.description: Leave empty to use this machine's default coding agent, the one `omarchy default agent` reports. Supported for suggestions: hermes, claude, codex, gemini, opencode. Name one to force it instead, such as `codex`. Only used when the Suggest button is pressed.

schema.label: Fetch the remote every (seconds)
schema.description: How often the source repo is fetched to count incoming commits. The normal re-check never touches the network; opening the panel also fetches.

schema.label: When everything is in sync
schema.description: Hide keeps the bar free of a permanent zero.

schema.label: Peer machine
schema.description: SSH host whose own check is shown in the panel. auto picks it from chezmoi's role (laptop -> desktop, desktop -> laptop). Empty disables it.

schema.label: Claude paths to watch
schema.description: Whitespace-separated paths under ~/.claude where files chezmoi neither manages nor ignores are counted. Empty disables it.
